title: South Carolina high school football poll for Sept. 2, 2025 | Myrtle Beach Sun News
text:
The Dorman Cavaliers moved into the top 10 in Class 5A as the latest SC High School Football Media poll was released Sept. 2, 2025. Alex Martin/Greenville News Alex Martin/Imagn Images Here are the rankings for the S.C. Prep Football Media Poll released Tuesday, Sept. 2. First-place votes and the team records are in parentheses.

2. Northwestern (1) (2-0)
3. Irmo (2-0)

6. Summerville (1-1)
